conclusion.selected_A: Concave root: local x<50,z>0 is air; the other three sufficiently near sectors are material. Physical interior angle is >180 degrees.
conclusion.preexisting_band: The upper visible band has concave curvature relative to its verified outward normal; the parallel back face is convex. This is an inside valley of a thin folded sheet.
conclusion.camera_or_mirror: A camera move or a rigid/mirror transform cannot change convexity or interior material angle. The frame determinant is positive. Verified face orientation does not merely invert lighting.
conclusion.reference_limit: The bitmap supplies visible projected edges but no solid classifier. Source convexity needs explicit visual interpretation or an accepted material-side constraint. Do not convert this audit of old BREP into a source truth claim.
